policy.contractStatus: PASS means the declared offline contract ran successfully
policy.productionStatus: NO_PROOF means production behavior was not exercised
policy.visualStatus: A generated result card is evidence of the contract run only
policy.staleSnapshots: NO_PROOF until sourceCommit and sourceTree match the current run

entries.title: Bounded fuzz harness
provenClaims: The bounded harness exercises seven registered synthetic targets.
Malformed and valid synthetic inputs are checked without panic.
Runner identity, limits, corpus policy and redaction are contract-validated.
notProven: Exhaustive vulnerability absence or penetration testing.
Production traffic, credentials, providers or external services.

entries.title: Release signing provenance contract
provenClaims: Ed25519 attestation and independent verification are contract-validated.
Digest, repository, commit, tree, channel, policy and signer mismatches fail closed.
Fixtures generate an ephemeral synthetic key pair in memory.
The deterministic SPDX SBOM generator and identity verifier are contract-validated.
notProven: A real release artifact was signed.
A production signing key or protected release environment was exercised.
An artifact was published or distributed.

entries.title: Installer identity contract
provenClaims: Linux, Windows and macOS targets are represented by a bounded contract matrix.
Artifact identity, canonical paths, simulated install state, uninstall policy and profile preservation are checked.
Unsafe metadata, traversal, wrong platform and digest mismatch are rejected.
notProven: A real installer was built or executed on any declared platform.
Native launch, uninstall or migration smoke tests on Linux, Windows or macOS.
Platform support beyond the contract-only matrix.
